verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only glancing bulk-style capabilities: bulk data import via CSV and Google Analytics, bulk export of stats, and a consolidated view across all sites. Nothing documents bulk actions on many items, and the Stats API is explicitly read-only, so it offers no programmatic bulk changes. Missing for 10: bulk create/edit/delete of sites, goals or other entities; a write-capable API for batch operations; documentation of batch workflows for AI agents; independent or hands-on corroboration.
